body:
Yes, it’s hard, very hard sometimes, but …

 White nationalism isn’t simply an extremist political ideology. It is an alt-religious movement that provides its adherents with its own twisted version of what all religions supply to adherents:  identity , a personal sense of who I am;  community , a social sense of where I belong; and  purpose , a spiritual sense of why my life matters. If faith communities don’t provide these healthy, life-giving human needs, then death-dealing alt-religions will fill the gap.

 More here.
